violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the employee bathroom was lacking paper towels. Paper towels were made available at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

Soap was not available at the employee bathroom hand-washing sink in the. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Soap was made available at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

Food items in the walk-in cooler were observed held at 51-66 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. All Time/Temperature Control for Safety (TCS) Foods were voluntarily disposed of by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

The following equipment was observed in need of repair/adjustment: - At the time of inspection, the walk-in cooler was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 60 degrees Fahrenheit with food items observed at 51-66 degrees Fahrenheit. Call was made for service, and repair person arrived at time of inspection. Unit is to be monitored with log sheet maintained for recording unit temperature at least every 3 hours. Log sheet printed for PIC at the time of inspection. - The Walk-in cooler door was observed not closing tightly (in need of a new/adjusted latch) - The walk-in cooler door was observed to have a torn gasket (in need of replacement) Walk-In Cooler is not to be used for storage of TCS Foods until unit is properly maintaining an ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. Hand Soap was provided at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2024

A Chlorine Sanitizer Spray bottle was observed not marked with the common name of the chemical. Working containers of chemicals taken from bulk are to be labeled with the common name of the chemical. New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2024

Chlorine sanitizer solution was observed in excess of 200 parts per million (ppm). A chlorine sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be between 50-100 ppm. (Sanitizer was adjusted to 50-100ppm at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2024

Working containers of dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2024
The walk-in cooler door gasket was observed in poor repair (torn/ripped). New Violation. Correct By: 03/05/2024

The sink used for food preparation is lacking a proper air gap (currently equipped with an air break). A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 03/31/2024
